query: SELECT t.id FROM tenants AS t WHERE t.state = 'deleted' AND t.content_removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM namespaces AS n WHERE n.tenant_id = t.id AND n.content_removed_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_grants AS g WHERE g.tenant_id = t.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_records AS r WHERE r.tenant_id = t.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_spend_days AS d WHERE d.tenant_id = t.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_generation_schedule AS s WHERE s.tenant_id = t.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credentials AS c WHERE c.tenant_id = t.id AND c.label <> $2) ORDER BY t.state_changed_at LIMIT $1 FOR NO KEY UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
